allot.text: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI(LODR) Regulations,2015,we would like to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company on May 29,2025, approve the allotment of 1,66,500 Equity Shares of Face value of Rs.2/- each as fully paid up to the eligible employees who have exercised their Stock Options (3rd Tranche)under JNK Employees Stock Option Plan,2022
